## Review of the last part

- Medium, apps/web/src/features/bin-area/bin-page.tsx:206 and packages/site/src/messages/en/admin.ts:63-66: A-19 (and its P4 line) say the games now at a restored game's time are named, as the publish preview names a clash; the screen only counts them ("Check it in Schedule"), so code and spec disagree (T-185). Fix: pass the clash ids on and list each game (teams, time, link), or correct A-19 to "counted".
- Medium, packages/core/src/modules/leagues/commands/restore-game.test.ts: nothing tests the `revision-out-of-date` path (revision number taken: the restore must be rolled back and the game stay in the bin), and the database tests only see `clashes: []`. Fix: a memory test with the next number already taken, and a pglite test with a game of a shared team at the same start.
- Medium, apps/web/src/features/access-area/admins-page.tsx:53: Latest changes reads the newest 100 entries of every kind and then keeps `access.*`; now that it reads the true log, a busy league's schedule and score entries push every access change out and the list shows none. Fix: pass `kind: 'access'` to `searchActivity`.
- Medium, restore-game.test.ts:91: the scope rule is untested: memoryBin grants are league-wide only, so no test shows a scheduler of one program refused another program's game (binSeasonScope). Fix: a program-scoped grant in the helper and a refusal test (or one in packages/database/src/stores/bin-commands.test.ts).
- Low, packages/core/src/modules/leagues/commands/restore-game.ts:93: the revision summary counts the restored game as `gamesAdded: 1` (and `gameIds.added`), so a future revision history will say a new game was added. Fix: count it only in `restoredFromBin`, or say in T-220 that added includes restored.
- Low, packages/core/src/modules/access/activity-search.ts:35-36: `leagues.restore_game` is found under Games, not Schedule, though it now makes a schedule revision; the log's Schedule filter misses it. Fix: add it to `schedule.also`.
- Low, apps/web/src/features/bin-area/bin-page.tsx:74 with bin-view.ts:146: for `team-short-name-taken` the other team is looked up by full name, so when another team holds the short name the sentence may name the wrong team "has this name"; the short-name branch has no test. Fix: look up by short name for that code and add a bin-view test.
- Low, packages/site/src/messages/en/admin.ts `admin.bin.nameTakenBy`: names the other team by the very same name, so it does not tell the two apart. Fix: add its short name or a link to its page in Teams.
- Low, bin-page.tsx:177-192: the revision, teams and people in the notice are read from the address, so a crafted `?back=game&revision=…` shows staff a made-up revision. Fix: read them back from the restore's log entry.
